notes:
• TimeBot Jr. now downloads its own updates. Click Install update at the bottom of the sidebar to install one right away, or it installs itself overnight while you're away.
• Close with a comment is on every ticket's right-click and ··· menu: your comment goes on the ticket as an internal note, then the ticket closes.
• After you close a ticket, an Undo button shows at the bottom of the window for a few seconds.
• From Friday on, My time has a Submit this week button, so you can submit your timesheet without going into ConnectWise.
• A ticket number in a note, like #26701, is now a link that opens that ticket.
• Tickets has My tickets and All tickets at the top: All shows everyone's, nobody's (unassigned) or one person's, and Open and Closed switches to tickets closed in the last 30 days.
• Filters on Tickets narrow the list by client, board, status or priority, and Save this view keeps a combination you use often as a one-click chip.
• Search is simpler, with a clear box to type in and the extra choices under Ticket options, and its tickets show when they were created and last updated again.
• The arrows for moving between weeks and months are bigger.
• Another day in Book time now opens the calendar wherever you click it.
• Clicking the TimeBot Jr. icon in the taskbar tray brings the window back where you left it instead of jumping to Tickets.
• A ticket that had another ticket merged into it now shows both emails.
• Booking time on a closed ticket now puts it back to closed afterwards, so you don't have to close it again.
• Booking time on a New or Assigned ticket moves it to In Progress.
• A split booking can now give its no charge part a note of its own.
• For managers: Invoice dates in Billing now match ConnectWise; they were showing a day early.
• For managers: Each client's page has a Revenue card with what was invoiced each month, what's still owed, its invoices, and how the client compares with the average client.
